checks.description: The complete report text has a whitespace-delimited word count within the resolved inclusive bounds.
The structured source inventory contains a number of cited substantive sources within the resolved inclusive bounds.
Each cited journal article/review qualifies under the journal rule, an explicit request exception, or a validated deep-only backward-reference overlap exception.
Each cited journal article or review has an article URL that resolves successfully; reachability does not verify article identity or findings.
Current manuscript citation keys, compiled bibliography and supplied cited-source inventory agree exactly, with matching input/output hashes.
Requested output formats correspond to the current compiled report and preserve supported document structures, with binary visual-review evidence recorded.

Secondary discovery is deep-only and one-hop, with frozen initial-pool citation evidence and journal exceptions limited to overlaps from at least two distinct initial works. Mechanical consistency does not establish research quality.

The discovered pool and rendered source list match a current qualification receipt, with second-record identity verification, journal compliance and at most one shortfall top-up. Discovery counts remain distinct from manuscript citation counts.
